about.text: Kalvdans is a classical Scandinavian dessert. It is made from unpasteurized colostrum milk, the first milk produced by a cow after giving birth.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: About one part colostrum to two parts ordinary milk, set in a water bath kept low so it does not boil; served chilled with cinnamon
